description: This file contains route handlers and utility functions for user settings management in a Fastify server, including profile updates, email confirmation, social links validation, and redirection logic.

methods.name: getWaitMessage
methods.description: Generates a message indicating how long a user must wait before requesting another authentication link.

methods.name: isPictureWithProtocol
methods.description: Checks if a URL string has a valid http or https protocol.

methods.name: validateImageExtension
methods.description: Checks if a URL contains a common image file extension.

methods.name: isValidPictureUrl
methods.description: Validates if a picture URL is either empty or has a valid protocol and extension.

methods.name: validateSocialUrl
methods.description: Validates social profile URLs against allowed domains.

methods.name: settingRoutes
methods.description: Defines various user setting API endpoints for profile, email, theme, social links, username, about, portfolio, experience, and other preferences.

methods.name: createUpdateEmailText
methods.description: Creates the email body text for email confirmation links.

methods.name: settingRedirectRoutes
methods.description: Defines email confirmation redirect logic, handling token validation and user email updates.
